jobs.title: Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Overview:

We are seeking for an Automation Engineer to support and further develop our laboratory automation environment. Working closely with our screening and assay scientists, you will implement robust automated workflows and keep our integrated systems running reliably.
The work ranges from day\-to\-day troubleshooting to evaluating new technologies.
Responsibilities:
* Implement, optimize and maintain automated workflows for screening and assay execution, including high\-throughput workflows in 384\- and 1536\-well formats.
* Program and configure automation, scheduling and instrument software, and develop C\# and Python scripts to support automation workflows and system integration.
* Integrate third\-party instruments into automated platforms.
* Support reliable connectivity and data flow between instruments, schedulers and LIMS.
* Maintain, troubleshoot and repair standalone and integrated automation equipment, coordinating vendor service where needed.
* Improve robotic scheduling, equipment utilization and overall workflow reliability.
* Evaluate new technologies through rapid prototyping, testing and implementation.
* Partner with screening teams to transfer established protocols onto automated platforms


Qualifications:
* 5\+ years of experience in laboratory automation, including automation support in a drug discovery environment.
* Hands\-on experience with robotics, integrated automation systems and a broad range of plate\-based instrumentation.
* Proven experience with HighRes Biosolutions automation systems and strong working knowledge of Cellario scheduling software.
* Experience with common liquid handling platforms (e.g., Hamilton, Tecan, Biomek, Bravo) and dispensing technologies (e.g. Combi, Tempest, Certus Flex and Echo acoustic dispensers).
* Advanced programming skills in C\# and Python, plus experience with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Proven troubleshooting ability across instruments, software and system communication.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including working with equipment vendors and external support teams.
* Working knowledge of additional scheduling platforms such as Green Button Go, Momentum, VWorks, DART or SAMI.
* Experience with LIMS and compound management platforms such as Mosaic or comparable systems.
* Familiarity with detection systems such as PHERAstar, high\-content imagers and qPCR instruments.
* Understanding of biochemical, biophysical and cell\-based assays, including technologies such as fluorescence, HTRF, AlphaLISA or NanoBRET.

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office –Inverness, Aberdeen, Glasgow or Perth


**Salary:** £51,600 \- £61,600 \+ car/cash allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of the SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works, we are looking for a Project Engineer – Interfaces to join our HVDC Engineering Team.



With several major HVDC projects underway, this is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering one of the UK's most significant energy infrastructure programmes and supporting the transition to Net Zero.



If you’ve developed your career in construction, consultancy, or client organisations and are ready to take on larger, more complex projects, this role will give you the platform to do so.


**You will**


* Manage engineering design interfaces across the multi\-contract delivery strategy, including HVDC, AC, Civils and Cables.


* Own and maintain the Design Interface Registers, working closely with contractors to align inputs, resolve design issues early, and ensure project information remains accurate and up to date.


* Manage the design submittals process through Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), supporting the timely delivery of high\-quality, traceable submissions.


* Act as a key link between SSEN teams and external partners, providing clear communication on interface risks, progress, key decisions and actions.


* Champion a positive safety culture and support compliance with CDM regulations and SSEN's engineering standards throughout the project lifecycle.


* Support the development of interface management best practice across the project, helping colleagues identify, manage and mitigate design and quality risks effectively.


**You have**


* A degree, or equivalent experience, in a relevant engineering discipline (preferably electrical, mechanical or civil engineering). Chartered status, or working towards it, is desirable.


* Proven experience delivering project engineering, design coordination, or interface management activities across complex, multi\-disciplinary projects.


* Proven ability to manage interfaces between teams, contractors, and disciplines, with a track record of identifying interface risks early and implementing effective mitigation measures.


* Experience supporting or leading elements of multi\-disciplinary design coordination, with a good understanding of how design, construction, and programme interdependencies are managed.


* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


* Experience using digital collaboration platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), or similar systems, to manage design submissions, interface registers and structured workflows.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits including a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Hannah on hannah.e.cutajar@sse.com / 01738 341147 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

Based in the beautiful city of Porto, you’ll be part of our collaborative Engineering & Development teams, working closely with your peers and decision-makers to maintain and develop our global services and products.

As a Software Engineer, you are a builder who bridges the gap between high-level requirements and high-performance reality. Having advanced past foundational concepts, you are currently dedicated to growing your expertise in designing distributed systems that scale effectively. You don't just write code that works; you write code that thrives under the pressure of global data scales.

You will be an integral part of the development cycle, owning features from design to deployment. Working within an agile team, you’ll encounter exciting technical challenges, from low-latency optimizations to complex B2B integrations, in a culture where your voice is heard and your growth is prioritized.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Service Evolution:
Develop and maintain our core backend and middleware services, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and ready for global traffic.

Architectural Input:
Don't just follow blueprints, help draw them. By collaborating with more senior colleagues, you’ll participate in the design of software architectures that solve real-world business problems.

Data at Scale:
Write highly efficient code capable of handling massive amounts of data with ease.

Performance Engineering:
Implement performance-critical and low-latency solutions where every millisecond counts.

Production Insight:
Keep the services you build healthy in production. You'll instrument, monitor, and log them, then use those signals to debug real live issues, with support from the team as you ramp up.

Collaborative Growth:
Work within a peer-led environment where you’ll receive mentorship to constantly level up the team’s collective skill set.

Code Craftsmanship:
Actively participate in code reviews, advocating for "clean code" principles and maintainability.

Global Integration:
Build and support B2B integrations with partners and clients across the world, ensuring our data flows seamlessly across the ecosystem.

WHO YOU ARE

The Foundation:
You hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or have a similar technical background. You have 2+ years of professional experience in a comparable software engineering role.

OOP Specialist:
You have a strong grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and understand how to apply design patterns to keep complex systems manageable.

Comfortable with .NET (or eager to learn):
You are comfortable using .NET/C# or similar C based languages
. While we value core engineering principles, you’ll be hitting the ground running in a working .NET environment.

Distributed Thinker:
You have "hands-on" experience (or a very strong conceptual understanding) of Microservices and how they communicate in a distributed world.

Tooling Savvy:
You are a fluent Git user and feel right at home in a terminal, perhaps even wielding PowerShell or Bash to automate your daily workflow.

Clean Code Advocate:
You believe that code is read more often than it is written. You take pride in naming, structure, and documentation. You recognize technical debt when you see it and work with the team to chip away at it.

Test-Minded:
You treat automated tests as part of “done”, not an afterthought. You write tests alongside your code so it stays robust and so the next person can change it safely.

Security & Privacy Conscious:
You apply basic security and privacy principles by default, handle user data responsibly without exception, and raise a flag early when you spot a concern.

Agile Mindset:
You thrive in a collaborative environment. You understand that "Agile" is about iterative value, transparency, and constant feedback. You can size and prioritize your own work with input from the team, and you raise a hand early when something drifts off track.

Great Communicator:
You have strong conversational English skills (written and spoken) and enjoy the dynamic of working with colleagues from different time zones and cultures.
